text: どくどくは　どくを　あびたら　１ターン　ごとに　どんどん　ダメージが　おおきく　なる！

structure.en: once you're hit with the poison

structure.jp: どんどん　ダメージが　おおきく　なる！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that thing happens. どくを　あびたら = 'once you're hit with the poison'.

patterns.name: 〜ごとに
patterns.explanation: ごとに after a thing means 'every' or 'each time'. １ターン　ごとに = 'every single turn'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing the い of a describing word to く and adding なる means 'become' that way. おおきく　なる = 'gets bigger'.
